description: Provides a complete and convenient set of API additions for building a DDD, CQRS and Event Sourcing enabled .NET application using Microsoft Dependency Injection, Microsoft Entity Framework Core, Dapper, AWS SNS/SQS, Azure Queue Storage/Azure Event Grid and RabbitMQ Worker Queue/Publish-Subscribe.
